hash_note: Input is CRLF; manifest digest matches exactly after CRLF-to-LF normalization. Input and manifest were not modified. Raw-byte digest retained separately.
independent_label_statement: In this labeling task only blinded.json and manifest.json were read as input. No *-original.json, predictions, current collector, real DB or reports read; no prediction run, network, or upload. Labels assigned from supplied title/snippet/URL before prediction comparison.
interpretation_notes: Named GitHub secure open-source fund is treated as a developer-support lead; identical named URLs grouped conservatively, with batch unspecified. No grant size/current opening/personal eligibility inferred.
Education/startup plan names without explicit benefits remain null; competition without described prize or free entitlement remains null.
Ordinary paid pricing, consumer freebies, feature announcements and ordinary open-source releases excluded under manifest scope.
limits: Bounded cached public sample, not platform-wide recall.
Eight per source cap creates a stratified sample, not deployment prevalence.
Observed snapshot time does not prove live availability.
Known URL overlap excluded; unknown historical semantic overlap cannot be ruled out.
Snippet truth uncertainty must remain null, never forced to pass.
A future fix informed by this sample makes it development data, not a new independent acceptance set.
Repeated same-source URLs mean row counts are not independent campaign counts.
No source-page verification: labels apply only to provided snippets.
Labels alone imply no classifier accuracy or 95% acceptance claim.
Any subsequent fix informed by this sample makes it development data.
